PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56816  Recommendation to approve October 16, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56817  Recommendation to approve Retirement Order Nos. 6189 to 6192 for inventory
  items that are no longer being used during the current year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56907  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for November 6, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56819  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal to provide Construction
  Management and Inspection Services for the Los Angeles Department of Water
  and Power (LADWP) Haynes Generating Station Recycled Water Pipeline Project
  (REO-0213), award a contract to DRP Engineering, Inc., in an amount not to
  exceed $2,012,370 for a period of three years, and authorize the General Manager
  to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56820  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-69-22 for the Los Angeles
  Department of Water and Power (LADWP) Haynes Generating Station Recycled
  Water Pipeline Project (REO-0213), award a contract to Toro Enterprises, Inc., in a
  total contract amount not to exceed $20,520,686 for a period of three years, and

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into
  the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56821  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute amendments to
  Agreement Nos. WD-3722 with General Pump Company, Inc.; WD-3723 with
  Layne Christensen Company; WD-3724 with L.O. Lynch Quality Wells & Pumps,
  Inc.; and WD-3725 with Best Drilling and Pump, Inc., to provide on-call services for
  well/pump repairs and rehabilitations, extending the term of each contract by one
  year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56822  Recommendation to adopt “Request for Proposal for Engineering Design Services
  for the Replacement of Forced [sic] Sewer Mains at Marina and Beach Sewer Lift
  Stations Project (SC-0515)”, award a contract to JIG Consultants in the amount not
  to exceed $519,900 for a period of two years, and authorize the General Manager
  to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-56825  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to issue a task order for
  engineering services for the Pier B Gas Pipeline Relocation Project, in an amount
  not to exceed $2,403,220 (which includes a 15% contingency), for a period of three
  years under Agreement No. UT-3937 with SPEC Services, Inc., for On-Call
  Engineering Services; authorize the General Manager to exercise the options to
  renew for two additional one-year periods under Agreement UT-3937; and
  authorize the General Manager to amend Agreement UT-3937 to include the Pier
  B Gas Pipeline Relocation Project’s scope of work and deliverables.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-56827  Recommendation to receive and file the Campus Realignment and Modernization
  update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-56826  Recommendation to adopt the proposed 2025-26 Public Policy Priorities for the
  Long Beach Public Utilities Department and authorize the General Manager to
  engage in advocacy activities, subject to the parameters adopted.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 2 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

11. 25-56830  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1543 which amends and restates
  Resolution No. WD-1355, establishing the following standing committees: (i) a
  Finance Committee; (ii) a Communications Committee; (iii) an Infrastructure
  Committee; (iv) a Planning Committee; and (v) a Resources Committee; and have
  the President of the Board appoint members and designate the Chair of each
  committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 25-56908  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Monthly Report for
  September and October 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than
72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the

the Board of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-
6626 (telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
